title: The Seasons
summary: Earth’s 23.5° tilt, not its distance from the Sun, gives us summer and winter, long and short days.

ib.note: Solar declination and insolation follow in DP

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 12: Earth, Moon, and the Sun (seasons)

objectives: I can explain seasons using the tilt of Earth’s axis as it orbits the Sun.
I can compare day length and noon Sun height at different places and times of year.
I can explain why places near the equator have little seasonal change.
misconceptions: Summer happens because Earth is closer to the Sun.
All places have the same seasons at the same time.
Day and night are always 12 hours each.
